name: CADReview — Human Feedback
protocol: CADReview arXiv v1 human-written-program test stratum, zero-shot feedback Acc. Machine-written programs, one-shot prompting, text metrics, and corrected-geometry metrics are excluded.

explanation.en: A sample is correct only when feedback identifies both the ground-truth erroneous code block and error class; the score is mean binary accuracy on the human-written stratum.
explanation.zh: 只有反馈同时命中标准错误代码块和错误类型时样本才算正确，分数是 human-written stratum 上的平均二元准确率。

summary.en: CADReview measures whether a multimodal model can locate and classify errors in an OpenSCAD program against intended multiview geometry.
summary.zh: CADReview 测试多模态模型能否根据目标多视图几何，定位并判断 OpenSCAD 程序中的错误。

task_format.en: The model sees correct reference renders, an erroneous block-labeled OpenSCAD program, and its render, then identifies the error block and class.
task_format.zh: 模型会看到正确参考渲染、带 block label 的错误 OpenSCAD 程序及其渲染图，然后定位错误 block 并判断错误类型。
